summary_en: JUKI authorized acquisition of up to 600,000 shares (2.0% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock) for a maximum 3.0 billion yen through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange from November 13 to December 30, 2026, to support shareholder returns, employee share plans, and flexible capital allocation.
title_en: Notice on Decision of Matters Concerning Acquisition of Treasury Stock (Acquisition of Treasury Stock Based on Articles of Incorporation Pursuant to Article 165, Paragraph 2 of the Companies Act)
translation_en_brief:
On November 12, 2026, JUKI's Board of Directors authorized the acquisition of treasury shares under Article 165(2) of the Companies Act. The company will repurchase up to 600,000 ordinary shares, representing 2.0% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock, for a maximum of 3.0 billion yen through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange between November 13 and December 30, 2026. At September 30, 2026, the company held 315,151 treasury shares against 29,559,028 shares outstanding.

The company cited three purposes for the buyback: returning capital to shareholders through flexible repurchase, securing shares for restricted stock grants to company executives and subsidiary officers, and enabling dynamic capital allocation in response to changing business conditions. The acquisition price was not capped but would not exceed the stated budget limit.
